what_it_does: Lakebase is now enabled by default in workspaces with the compliance security profile, including workspaces that use the HIPAA, C5, or TISAX standard and workspaces that enable the profile without a compliance standard. You no longer need to enable Lakebase in these workspaces. Lakebase Postgres provides data protection features to help secure your databases and control access to critical data.
